title: E224｜深度拆解Clawdbot，为何它能成为2026年第一个现象级产品？
title_en: E224｜A Deep Dive on Clawdbot: Why Did It Become 2026's First Phenomenon Product?
eyebrow: AI & Tech Products · AI 与科技产品
summary_cn: 一句话概括：硅谷101邀请用户侧知县、软件算法侧华祯豪Troy、硬件侧叶天奇，从活人感（长期记忆+主动性）、MD记忆架构、心跳机制到Mac mini隔离部署，全方位拆解Clawdbot/OpenClaw为何成为2026第一个现象级Agent产品，并展望一人公司与按爬取付费的新商业模式
summary_en: Silicon Valley 101 brings in Zhixian from the user side, Troy Hua from the software and algorithm side, and Ye Tianqi from the hardware side to dissect why Clawdbot and OpenClaw became 2026's first phenomenon-level agent product — through 'alive-ness' (long-term memory plus initiative), the MD memory architecture, heartbeat mechanisms, and isolated deployment on a Mac mini. They also look ahead to the new business models of one-person companies and pay-per-crawl.

scenes.title_cn: 一、为何是Clawdbot火了？现象级产品的灵魂
scenes.title_en: Why Clawdbot Blew Up: The Soul of a Phenomenon Product
scenes.context: Long-term memory, proactive behavior, and IM-based interaction are what make the agent feel alive. 语域：casual 产品点评 + 播客分享。
scenes.speak: The core mechanism: long-term memory lets it remember conversations and preferences across sessions; initiative shows in daily greetings, pre-researching tasks, and life reminders — it can joke and tease like JARVIS. AI initiative isn't a new concept, but Clawdbot is the first product to nail memory plus initiative plus IM all at once, so ordinary people can feel the progress. A typical scene: you murmur 'the beef won't last much longer,' and the agent adds a reminder on its own and nudges you about the right cooking time in the afternoon. Users describe it as 'that kind of super-proactive subordinate… once you use it, you can't go back.' And because it lives inside familiar messaging apps like WeChat and Feishu, talking to it feels like chatting with a colleague, not typing in a terminal.

sentences.cn: 核心机制：长期记忆能记住跨会话对话与偏好；主动性体现在每日问候、任务预研、生活提醒推送，像JARVIS一样会抖机灵吐槽
sentences.en: The core mechanism: long-term memory lets it remember cross-session conversations and preferences; initiative shows up in daily greetings, pre-researching tasks, and life reminders — it even jokes and teases like JARVIS.
sentences.note: 表达提示long-term memory → 长期记忆；initiative → 主动性；cross-session → 跨会话；proactive → 主动的

sentences.cn: 关键理解：AI主动性不是新概念，但Clawdbot是第一个把记忆+主动+IM三者做到位、让普通人感知到技术进步的产品
sentences.en: The key insight: AI initiative isn't a new concept, but Clawdbot is the first product to nail memory plus initiative plus IM together, so ordinary people can actually feel the technology getting better.
sentences.note: 表达提示nail … together → 把…同时做到位；feel the progress → 感知到进步

sentences.cn: 典型场景：碎碎念「牛肉再不吃了」，Agent自动加入reminder并在下午主动提醒烹饪时机
sentences.en: A typical scene: you murmur 'the beef won't last much longer,' and the agent adds a reminder on its own and proactively nudges you about the right cooking moment in the afternoon.
sentences.note: 表达提示murmur → 碎碎念；nudge → 提醒；cooking moment → 烹饪时机

sentences.cn: （引用）"就那种特别主动性的下属的这种感觉……用了就回不去了。"
sentences.en: 'It's that feeling of a super-proactive subordinate… once you use it, you can't go back.'
sentences.note: 表达提示proactive subordinate → 主动的下属；can't go back → 用了就回不去

sentences.cn: （引用）原文依据：知县描述Agent根据碎碎念自动处理牛肉提醒，并强调「牛肉一定要最后两三分钟放，要不然会煮老」
sentences.en: Zhixian describes how the agent turned a murmur about beef into an automatic reminder, and stresses: 'the beef has to go in the last two or three minutes, or it gets overcooked.'
sentences.note: 表达提示overcook → 煮老；reminder → 提醒事项

sentences.cn: 核心机制：用户已熟悉的消息传递方式（微信、飞书）让Agent感觉像跟同事聊天，而非在Terminal里对话
sentences.en: The core mechanism: living inside messaging apps people already use, like WeChat and Feishu, makes the agent feel like chatting with a colleague — not like typing in a terminal.
sentences.note: 表达提示messaging app → 即时通讯；feel like chatting with a colleague → 像跟同事聊天；terminal → 终端

scenes.title_cn: 二、惊艳用例：Agent自主能力的边界
scenes.title_en: Impressive Use Cases: The Boundaries of Agent Autonomy
scenes.context: The agent publishes blog posts, reads repo rules, and even operates Gemini's web UI — autonomously. 语域：casual 演示 + 技术点评。
scenes.speak: Zhixian asked the agent to test the macOS local-model API. After testing, it automatically wrote an article in the user's voice, published it to his bilingual blog, and set the tags and categories itself. The agent read the whole repo's rules and figured out the configuration on its own, without any follow-up questions — the publish took about ten seconds and it tossed back two links. The practical tip: give the agent a clear goal, like write and publish, and let it explore the repo rules itself — this suits developers with custom blog setups. Start with small experiments to probe the agent's capability boundaries, then gradually open up publishing permissions. And when there was no image-generation API key, the agent opened the Gemini web page by itself, typed in the prompt, generated the image, saved it via Playwright, pushed it to the blog as cover.png, and wrapped the whole flow into a Skill.

sentences.cn: 在讲什么：知县让Agent测试MacOS本地模型API，测完后自动以用户口吻写文章、发布到中英文博客，配好tag和category
sentences.en: What happened: Zhixian asked the agent to test the macOS local-model API. After testing, it automatically wrote an article in the user's voice, published it to his bilingual blog, and set the tags and categories itself.
sentences.note: 表达提示local-model API → 本地模型 API；in the user's voice → 以用户口吻；bilingual blog → 中英文博客

sentences.cn: 关键理解：Agent参考整个repo规则自行摸清配置，无需中间追问，10秒完成发布并甩两个链接
sentences.en: The key insight: the agent read the entire repo's rules and figured out the configuration on its own, without any follow-up questions — publishing took about ten seconds and it tossed back two links.
sentences.note: 表达提示figure out the configuration → 摸清配置；follow-up questions → 追问；toss back → 甩回

sentences.cn: 怎么用：给Agent明确目标（写文+发布），让它自主探索仓库规则；适合有自定义博客配置的开发者
sentences.en: How to use it: give the agent a clear goal, like write and publish, and let it explore the repo rules itself; this suits developers with custom blog setups.
sentences.note: 表达提示clear goal → 明确目标；custom blog setup → 自定义博客配置

sentences.cn: （引用）原文依据：「也就用了10秒左右的时间吧，然后甩了两个链接给我……人家配的比我配的还好啊」
sentences.en: 'It only took about ten seconds, then it tossed two links back to me… it configured it better than I did.'
sentences.note: 表达提示configure … better than → 配得比…还好

sentences.cn: （引用）落地建议：先让Agent做小实验验证能力边界，再逐步放开发布权限
sentences.en: Practical advice: first run small experiments to probe the agent's capability boundaries, then gradually open up publishing permissions.
sentences.note: 表达提示capability boundary → 能力边界；publishing permission → 发布权限

sentences.cn: 核心机制：无生图API Key时，Agent自动打开Gemini网页输入提示词、生成、通过Playwright复制保存图片、推送到博客命名为cover.png，并封装成Skill
sentences.en: The core mechanism: with no image-generation API key, the agent opened the Gemini web page itself, typed in the prompt, generated the image, saved it via Playwright, pushed it to the blog named cover.png, and packaged the whole flow as a Skill.
sentences.note: 表达提示image-generation API key → 生图 API 密钥；web page → 网页；package as a Skill → 封装成技能

scenes.title_cn: 三、技术拆解：MD记忆与心跳机制
scenes.title_en: Under the Hood: MD Memory and the Heartbeat Mechanism
scenes.context: How the agent's memory is stored as markdown files, searched by vectors and keywords, and updated by a heartbeat. 语域：formal 技术拆解 + 播客点评。
scenes.speak: Memory comes in two kinds. Personality memory — identity, speaking style, and what to call you — lives in files like SOUL.md; factual and working memory is stored by date in daily index files, tracking progress and todos. Technically it's just loading markdown content into context. The personality memory borrows from 2D role-play projects; the factual memory borrows from Cloud Code's CLAUDE.md approach. On your first chat, the agent keeps asking 'what should I call you?' and 'what's your name?' then stores the answers permanently. Compared with context compression, structured markdown storage is more persistent and stable — key information doesn't get truncated when the window rolls. Search is seventy percent vector semantic matching and thirty percent BM25 keyword search, giving second-level memory recall.

sentences.cn: 核心机制：记忆分两类——Personality记忆（identity、说话方式、用户称呼）存在SOUL.md等文件；事实/工作记忆按日期存daily index文件，记录工作进展与待办
sentences.en: The core mechanism: memory comes in two kinds — Personality memory, covering identity, speaking style, and how to address you, stored in files like SOUL.md; and factual or working memory, stored by date in daily index files that record progress and todos.
sentences.note: 表达提示personality memory → 人格记忆；working memory → 工作记忆；daily index → 按日期索引

sentences.cn: 关键理解：技术上就是把MD文件内容load进context；Personality记忆借鉴二次元角色扮演项目，事实记忆借鉴Cloud Code的CLAUDE.md实现
sentences.en: The key insight: technically it's just loading the markdown files' content into the context. The personality memory borrows from 2D role-play projects, and the factual memory borrows from Cloud Code's CLAUDE.md implementation.
sentences.note: 表达提示load into context → 加载进上下文；role-play project → 角色扮演项目；borrow from → 借鉴

sentences.cn: 典型场景：初次聊天Agent会反复问「你希望我叫什么」「你叫什么」，拿到后持久存储
sentences.en: A typical scene: in the first chat, the agent keeps asking 'what should I call you?' and 'what's your name?' and then stores the answers for good.
sentences.note: 表达提示store … for good → 永久存储；address you → 称呼你

sentences.cn: （引用）原文依据：华祯豪「技术上的话就是把这些文件的内容load到他的context里，然后就去使用了」
sentences.en: Troy explains: 'Technically, we load the content of these files into its context, and then it just uses them.'
sentences.note: 表达提示technically → 技术上；use them → 直接使用

sentences.cn: （引用）与Context压缩的区别：MD结构化存储比压缩更确保持久稳定，不会因窗口截断丢失关键信息
sentences.en: Compared with context compression: structured markdown storage is more persistent and stable than compression — key information won't be lost when the window gets truncated.
sentences.note: 表达提示context compression → 上下文压缩；persistent and stable → 持久稳定；truncate → 截断

sentences.cn: 核心机制：向量语义匹配占70%，BM25关键词搜索占30%，实现秒级记忆定位
sentences.en: The core mechanism: vector semantic matching accounts for 70% and BM25 keyword search 30%, achieving second-level memory recall.
sentences.note: 表达提示vector semantic matching → 向量语义匹配；BM25 keyword search → BM25 关键词搜索；recall → 定位/召回

paraphrase.intent: 想说「记忆就是往上下文里塞文件」
phrases: It's literally just stuffing markdown into the context.
No magic — the files are the memory.
paraphrase.chunks: stuffing into context · the files are the memory
paraphrase.usage: stuffing 是形象口语；the files are the memory 是精炼总结

paraphrase.intent: 想说「结构化存储比压缩更可靠」
phrases: Structured storage beats compression for persistence.
Compression loses details; structured files keep them.

scenes.title_cn: 四、安全部署与成本管控
scenes.context: Why you should isolate the agent on a spare machine, and how subscription tokens keep costs flat. 语域：formal 安全建议 + 成本分析。
scenes.speak: Because the agent holds tons of sensitive permissions and can execute them directly, the best practice is isolated deployment — don't run it on your main computer. Use a Mac mini or a VPS for physical isolation, and only give the agent access to data you're willing to share. If you want maximum privacy you'd need a local model, but performance falls short. Deploying on your main machine is lethal — it's like inviting a hacker in. The guests agree 'this is terrifying, I wouldn't dare use it' is a reasonable reaction; one incident already leaked usernames, passwords, and emails. On cost: logging in with a Claude Pro or Max subscription's setup token keeps costs flat with a fixed monthly fee, so you never fear burning tokens; API-key pay-per-use spirals out of control in high-consumption scenarios. A two-hundred-dollar monthly plan running five agents plus coding tasks is basically enough; high token consumption usually comes from crawlers, screenshots, and other expensive operations, not the bot mechanism itself.

sentences.cn: 原因：Agent拥有系统大量隐秘权限且可直接执行，最佳方案是隔离部署，不要在主力电脑上使用
sentences.en: The reason: the agent holds a lot of sensitive system permissions and can execute them directly, so the best practice is isolated deployment — don't run it on your main computer.
sentences.note: 表达提示sensitive permissions → 敏感权限；isolated deployment → 隔离部署；best practice → 最佳方案

sentences.cn: 解法：Mac mini/VPS物理隔离 + 只给Agent访问愿意分享的数据；追求极致隐私需本地模型但性能不足
sentences.en: The solution: a Mac mini or VPS provides physical isolation, and you only give the agent access to the data you're willing to share; for maximum privacy you'd need a local model, but performance isn't good enough yet.
sentences.note: 表达提示physical isolation → 物理隔离；willing to share → 愿意分享；local model → 本地模型

sentences.cn: 严重程度：致命——主力机部署等于请黑客进门
sentences.en: Severity: lethal — deploying on your main machine is like inviting a hacker through the front door.
sentences.note: 表达提示lethal → 致命的；invite a hacker in → 请黑客进门

sentences.cn: （引用）嘉宾共识：「这个太可怕了不敢用」是合理反应；Moltbook还暴露了用户名密码邮件等敏感信息泄露
sentences.en: The guests' consensus: 'this is too scary, I wouldn't dare use it' is a reasonable reaction; one incident already exposed usernames, passwords, and email addresses.
sentences.note: 表达提示consensus → 共识；leak sensitive info → 泄露敏感信息

sentences.cn: 核心机制：用Claude Pro/Max订阅的Setup Token登录，固定月费不怕烧Token；API Key按量计费在高消耗场景下成本失控
sentences.en: The core mechanism: logging in with the Setup Token from a Claude Pro or Max subscription keeps the cost flat with a fixed monthly fee, so you never worry about burning tokens; API keys billed per usage spin out of control in high-consumption scenarios.
sentences.note: 表达提示Setup Token → 设置令牌；fixed monthly fee → 固定月费；burn tokens → 烧 Token

sentences.cn: 关键理解：200刀/月套餐跑5个Agent+编程任务基本够用；Token消耗大往往是因为爬虫、截屏等高耗操作，非Bot本身机制导致
sentences.en: The key insight: a two-hundred-dollar monthly plan running five agents plus coding tasks is basically sufficient; high token burn usually comes from crawlers, screenshots, and other costly operations, not from the bot's own mechanism.
sentences.note: 表达提示high-consumption scenario → 高消耗场景；crawler → 爬虫；screenshot → 截屏

phrases: Never run it on your daily driver.
Keep it quarantined on a spare machine.
paraphrase.chunks: daily driver · quarantined on a spare machine
paraphrase.usage: daily driver 指主力电脑，口语地道；quarantine 有隔离感

scenes.title_en: Agent Hardware: Defining a New Category
scenes.context: What an agent-dedicated computer looks like when you strip away everything designed for humans. 语域：formal 硬件前瞻 + 播客点评。
scenes.speak: Work splits into foreground, which needs a screen, and background, which runs silently. Agent computers belong to the background category, while big phone and computer makers chase the foreground. The key parameter is RAM: it decides how many agents you can run — four gigabytes starts choking at just two. Storage matters too, because a knowledge worker's chat content turns into knowledge assets, and users often hang an external SSD off it. You can strip the screen, which matters little when agents are doing the work, plus all the redundancy designed for humans; beef up the IO ports and status lights instead. If all my work were done without a screen, what would my phone even be for? The Mac mini is still designed for humans; a dedicated agent machine can cut the redundancy to lower cost. Ye Tianqi firmly believes this is a new category, though the agent entry point and compute aren't necessarily tied. Some people at his company already carry only an iPad, with work automated on agent devices.

sentences.cn: 核心机制：工作分Foreground（需屏幕）和Background（后台默默跑）；Agent电脑属于后者，大厂手机/电脑厂做前者
sentences.en: The core mechanism: work splits into Foreground tasks that need a screen and Background tasks that run silently; agent computers belong to the background category, while the big phone and computer makers chase the foreground.
sentences.note: 表达提示foreground / background → 前台/后台；agent computer → Agent 电脑；run silently → 后台默默跑

sentences.cn: 关键参数：RAM决定能跑多少Agent（4GB只能跑2个就卡）；存储也重要，知识工作者聊天内容会转化为知识资产，用户常外挂SSD
sentences.en: Key parameters: RAM decides how many agents you can run — 4GB starts to choke at just two; storage also matters, because a knowledge worker's chat content turns into knowledge assets, and users often hang an external SSD off the device.
sentences.note: 表达提示key parameter → 关键参数；choke → 卡顿；external SSD → 外挂硬盘；knowledge asset → 知识资产

sentences.cn: 可砍掉：屏幕（Agent调用时作用不大）、为人类设计的冗余能力；强化IO接口和状态指示灯
sentences.en: What you can strip: the screen, which does little when agents are handling the calls, plus the redundant capabilities designed for humans; instead, strengthen the IO interfaces and status indicator lights.
sentences.note: 表达提示redundancy → 冗余能力；IO interface → IO 接口；status light → 状态指示灯

sentences.cn: （引用）"你如果把我的这些工作都以不需要屏幕的形式做掉了，那我的手机存在意义是什么？"
sentences.en: 'If you can do all my work in a screen-less form, then what's the point of my phone?'
sentences.note: 表达提示what's the point of → …的存在意义是什么；screen-less form → 不需要屏幕的形式

sentences.cn: （引用）与Mac mini的关系：Mac mini本质还是为人类设计，Agent专用硬件可以砍掉冗余降成本
sentences.en: The Mac mini connection: the Mac mini is still designed for humans; an agent-dedicated machine can cut the redundancy and lower the cost.
sentences.note: 表达提示dedicated machine → 专用设备；cut the redundancy → 砍掉冗余

sentences.cn: 叶天奇坚信这是新品类，但Agent入口和算力不一定绑定。公司内部已有人只带iPad，工作转移到Agent设备自动化。边缘计算硬件端需有特有功能，而非简单中控
sentences.en: Ye Tianqi firmly believes this is a new category, though the agent's entry point and compute aren't necessarily bound together. Inside his company, some people already carry only an iPad, with their work moved to automated agent devices. Edge-computing hardware needs a distinctive function, not just being a simple hub.
sentences.note: 表达提示new category → 新品类；bound together → 绑定；edge-computing hardware → 边缘计算硬件；hub → 中控

paraphrase.intent: 想说「手机的存在意义被抽空」
phrases: If the agent does it all, my phone becomes pointless.
The phone's reason to exist evaporates.
paraphrase.chunks: become pointless · reason to exist evaporates
paraphrase.usage: reason to exist 比 meaning 更地道

scenes.title_cn: 六、商业展望与组织重塑
scenes.context: One-person companies, agents as a legion you command, and why multi-agent teams need a general. 语域：formal 商业展望 + 播客点评。
scenes.speak: Early signals: an e-commerce agency friend already sees ten percent of client traffic coming through agents, and founders are registering .md domains in droves. Agents communicate cheaply, are born to document everything, and suit a group-style push — but you need the know-how to act as the general; letting an agent run wild in a domain you don't understand turns into a disaster movie. The biggest cost of a human team is communication and management — information loss and alignment meetings; agents talk fast and love writing docs, though their long-term memory is still weak. A zero-person company isn't realistic; a one-person company absolutely is, but the human must know the direction and be able to judge. 'You need the know-how… you're the general of this legion, but the legion you get is many times more powerful than a purely human one.' Multi-agent collaboration can develop human-style blame-shifting, so you need a superior agent to make decisions; production environments need transparent review mechanisms and system-level rollback.

sentences.cn: （引用）原文依据：电商代运营朋友客户已有10%流量从Agent倒过去；创始人大量注册.md域名
sentences.en: Early signals: an e-commerce agency friend's clients already get about 10% of their traffic through agents, and founders are registering .md domains in droves.
sentences.note: 表达提示e-commerce agency → 电商代运营；in droves → 大量；.md domains → md 域名

sentences.cn: 核心机制：Agent沟通成本低、天生爱文档化、适合集团式推进；但你需要有know-how做「将军」，不懂领域让Agent乱搞会拍烂片
sentences.en: The core mechanism: agents communicate cheaply, are naturally document-oriented, and suit a group-style push; but you need the know-how to act as the general — let an agent run wild in a domain you don't understand and it'll ruin the film.
sentences.note: 表达提示document-oriented → 爱文档化；group-style push → 集团式推进；act as the general → 当将军；ruin the film → 拍烂片

sentences.cn: 关键理解：人类团队最大成本是沟通管理（信息折损、对齐会议）；Agent之间沟通快、爱写文档，但长期记忆仍不够好
sentences.en: The key insight: the biggest cost of a human team is communication and management — information loss and alignment meetings; agents talk fast and love writing docs, though their long-term memory still isn't good enough.
sentences.note: 表达提示information loss → 信息折损；alignment meeting → 对齐会议；long-term memory → 长期记忆

sentences.cn: 适用边界：零人公司不靠谱；一人公司绝对可行，但人必须懂方向有评判能力
sentences.en: The boundary: a zero-person company isn't reliable; a one-person company is absolutely viable, but the human has to know the direction and be able to judge quality.
sentences.note: 表达提示zero-person company → 零人公司；one-person company → 一人公司；judge quality → 有评判能力

sentences.cn: （引用）"你得有know-how……你是这个军团的将军，但你得到的军团比纯人肉军团强大非常多倍。"
sentences.en: 'You need the know-how… you're the general of this legion, but the legion you get is many, many times more powerful than a purely human one.'
sentences.note: 表达提示know-how → 领域经验；legion → 军团；many times more powerful → 强大非常多倍

sentences.cn: 原因：多Agent协作会出现人类式推责，需设计上级Agent做决策；生产环境需透明审核机制和系统级回滚能力
sentences.en: The reason: multi-agent collaboration can develop human-style blame-shifting, so you need a superior agent to make decisions; production environments need transparent review mechanisms and system-level rollback capability.
sentences.note: 表达提示blame-shifting → 推责；transparent review → 透明审核；system-level rollback → 系统级回滚

paraphrase.intent: 想说「你当将军，Agent 当军团」
phrases: You command the legion; the agents do the heavy lifting.
You bring the strategy, they bring the manpower.
paraphrase.chunks: command the legion · bring the strategy
paraphrase.usage: command 有统帅意味，比 lead 更贴合「将军」意象

phrases: Don't delegate what you don't understand.
No know-how, no autonomy for the agent.
paraphrase.chunks: delegate what you don't understand · no autonomy
paraphrase.usage: delegate 是授权管理的标准动词

practice.cn: 用「can't go back」说：用了就回不去了。
practice.en: Once you use a proactive agent like this, you can't go back to plain chat.

practice.cn: 用「hand over the keys」说：先探测边界再放开权限。
practice.en: Probe the agent's boundaries first — then hand over the keys.

practice.cn: 用「daily driver」说：别在主力机跑。
practice.en: Never deploy it on your daily driver — use a spare Mac mini instead.

practice.cn: 用「token anxiety」说：订阅制让你不怕烧 Token。
practice.en: A flat subscription kills the token anxiety completely.

pitfalls.right: The agent feels genuinely alive — proactive, memory-driven, and quick to tease.
pitfalls.why: 「聪明」用 clever 太笼统；现象级产品的关键卖点是 alive / proactive 的体验。

pitfalls.wrong: The agent knows everything about me.
pitfalls.right: The agent holds deep access to your system — which is exactly why you must isolate it.
pitfalls.why: 「知道我一切」不是卖点是风险；hold deep access 才能引出隔离部署的结论。

pitfalls.wrong: It published the blog in 10 seconds.
pitfalls.right: It configured the repo itself and published within about ten seconds.
pitfalls.why: 漏掉 configure itself 就丢掉了最惊人的部分——自主摸清配置。

pitfalls.wrong: Multi-agents may argue with each other.
pitfalls.right: Multi-agent teams can develop human-style blame-shifting, so a superior agent must make decisions.
pitfalls.why: 不是吵架，是「推责」；blame-shifting 才是节目讨论的组织问题。

shifts.before: 以为 AI 助手只是被动的问答工具
shifts.after: 现象级 Agent 的体验是「活人感」：长期记忆 + 主动性 + IM 交互

shifts.before: 以为给 Agent 越权越多越好
shifts.after: 必须物理隔离部署——主力机跑等于请黑客进门
沟通成本才是团队最大成本；一人公司 + Agent 军团可能更高效
